scopeNotes: Bounded reference covering 13 named common DJ products, not every DJ device or every historical firmware.
This file describes device storage/audio/library support; operating-system filesystem read/write support is maintained separately.
Model compatibility announcements, USB library format support and software major versions are separate facts.
Evidence values use JSON true, false or the string unknown. Conditional support requires reading firmwareConditions before recommending a format.
Only manufacturer documentation, official support/release notes and manufacturer-hosted user guides are used. No real user database or disk was read or changed.
A source listing a filesystem does not prove read/write compatibility on every USB controller. No physical DJ-player acceptance was performed.
An unqualified legacy vendor FAT label is preserved as a source note; its exact subtype is not automatically treated as verified FAT16.

Optical-disc, LINK Export, Performance mode and streaming restrictions can differ from USB standalone playback. General-format FAQ facts are labelled when a USB-specific codec table was not independently reviewed.
For audio rows marked sampleRateListExhaustive=false, an unlisted rate is unknown rather than unsupported. verifiedSampleRatesHz identifies the positively confirmed subset.

deviceLibrary.label: Device Library
deviceLibrary.description: Traditional rekordbox USB/SD exported performance-data library.

deviceLibraryPlus.label: Device Library Plus
deviceLibraryPlus.description: Previous name for the newer USB library; supported by rekordbox 6 releases before the OneLibrary rename.

oneLibrary.label: OneLibrary
oneLibrary.description: Device Library Plus was renamed in rekordbox 7.2.5; AlphaTheta states rekordbox exports under the two names are fully compatible.

engineDj.label: Engine DJ library
engineDj.description: Engine DJ / Engine OS preparation and performance library; do not equate it with rekordbox library formats.

libraryDefinitions.internalFormatEvidenceNote: The reviewed official sources do not establish a PDB or SQLite on-disk schema. Those internal representations are deliberately not asserted.

versionAdvisories.evidenceOwner: Root agent separately verified the official notice
versionAdvisories.notes: A specific USB export bug is a separate diagnosis from Device Library/OneLibrary mismatch or a software-major-version transition. Check the root-maintained interop advisory for later fixes.
